Girdwood Land Use Committee
                    Notice of Meeting on Sept 14 2026 7PM
                              Minutes Draft

Meeting will take place via Teams teleconference and in person at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd.

The following items have been submitted as agenda items for consideration at the meeting of the Girdwood Land Use Committee. A
voting member is any Girdwood Valley resident eighteen (18) years of age or older. Non-resident property owners, businesses, and
non-profit associations are allowed one (1) vote per entity. Detailed voting qualifications can be found in the rules outlined in the
Girdwood Land Use Committee Operating Principles.
The Girdwood Land Use Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Agenda Item LUC 2609-01:
Land Acknowledgement: As we gather with a common intention for our GVSA this evening, LUC would like to begin by acknowledging
the stewardship of the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we reside on and the surrounding waters we depend on.
The current area of Girdwood is situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland. A necessary connection for
Alaska Native people, the landscape and waters around us served to carry their traditional ways of life; to gather here and harvest
Native foods. The community of Girdwood respects the Dena'ina and Alutiiq people, who were stewards of this land for generations.
We will continue to be stewards of this land and are grateful to be a part of this community.

7PM Call to order Brice Wilbanks, Co-chair

Old Business:
Agenda Item LUC 2606-05: FCC Delegate from GBOS (Wingard)
GBOS seeking LUC input on having a delegate representing Girdwood at FCC. All community councils are automatically considered
members. Question currently is if Girdwood wants to have an official delegate representing the community.
Current delegate from Girdwood is Jennifer Wingard, elected last year. She states that there have been helpful elements of FCC
information sharing. Girdwood has strong participation and involvement compared to other neighborhoods in Anchorage. GBOS is the
community council ex-officio, but LUC is the meeting with true community input.
Anyone can attend FCC meetings, without being a delegate. Non-delegates may not have designated time to speak separately from
public comment.

Motion:
LUC moves to recommend to GBOS that Girdwood does not have a formal delegate to the Federation of Community Councils.
Motion by Jerry Fox/2nd Carol Fox
Vote by hand on line and in person
4 in favor, 0 opposed, 4 abstain
Motion carries

Agenda Item LUC 2606:06: LUC co-chair vacancy
No nominations heard.


Agenda Item LUC 2609:04: LUC recommendation for GBOS Resolution of Support to transfer Girdwood Industrial Park lot, HLB
Parcel ID 6-057K (Parcel ID 075-131-18) to MOA Street Maintenance – Girdwood. Action needed for HLBAC meeting in September.
Request to hear as old business, due to time constraints.

Motion:
LUC moves to move LUC Item 2609-04 to Old Business due to time constraints:
Motion by Jerry Fox/Carol Fox
Motion carries by assent

This project has been in the works for many years. Having the lot under MOA Street Maintenance – Girdwood will allow for lot
improvements. Platting effort supports this project and needs of the community.

Motion:
LUC moves to recommend GBOS Resolution of Support for transfer of the Girdwood Industrial Park lot HLB Parcel ID 6-057K (Parcel
ID 075-131-18) to MOA Street Maintenance – Girdwood.
Motion by Jerry Fox/2nd Carol Fox
Vote by hand on line and in room:
6 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstain
Motion carries
